title: Metadata Diagnostics paints its header as an error when there are zero issues — red alert icon and a red "0 issue(s) across 396 items in 27 types" badge above "All clear" (DiagnosticsPage styles the header destructive unconditionally)
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible defect in a status signal, not an aesthetic preference. The page uses the error colour and the alert glyph to report success, so the one signal the page exists to give contradicts its own body text.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23942 · studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep · observation (studio-authoring runner; re-checked and filed under objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878)

## What happens

The diagnostics header always carries `AlertTriangle` in `text-destructive` and a badge in destructive colours, whatever the count. On a healthy boot the page reads "All clear · Scanned 396 item(s) across 27 type(s) — no issues found" in its body, while the header shows a red warning triangle and a red badge "0 issue(s) across 396 items in 27 types". An admin glancing at the page, or at a screenshot of it, reads "problems found".

## Reach — measured, 2/2 fresh loads

Environment: objectstack `7277c07f` (main, 2026-10-16), `examples/app-showcase` booted from a main worktree: `OS_PORT=47321 objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 47321 -d file:…/data.db`, with a fresh DB. Console: objectui `daeb77fc` (the `.objectui-sha` pin), built against `@objectstack/spec` from `a35f7a67^` (`34b740f2`), because the pin does not build on main (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23885 / #23908). `check:console-sha` matches. Playwright with `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, form sign-in as the seeded admin, and a screenshot taken before every DOM read. Code path re-read on objectui main `023087f63`, where it is still present.

1. Stock showcase, fresh DB, nothing authored.
2. Open `/_console/apps/setup/metadata/_diagnostics` (Setup → Configuration → Diagnostics).
3. The h1 icon class is `lucide-triangle-alert … text-destructive`. The badge text is `0 issue(s) across 396 items in 27 types`, with class `… border-destructive/40 text-destructive bg-destructive/[0.06]`. The body shows `All clear` and `Scanned 396 item(s) across 27 type(s) — no issues found.` Same on two fresh loads, and the screenshot confirms red over "All clear".

- **Expected:** with zero issues the header reads as success or neutral (no alert glyph, a neutral or success badge). The destructive styling is kept for a non-zero error count, with warnings in the warning colour.
- **Actual:** destructive styling at zero.

## Where (objectui main `023087f63`)

- `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/DiagnosticsPage.tsx:72-74`: `<AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-destructive" />` in the h1, unconditional.
- `DiagnosticsPage.tsx:76-79`: `<Badge variant="outline" className="… border-destructive/40 text-destructive bg-destructive/[0.06]">` around `engine.diagnostics.summary`, unconditional.
- `DiagnosticsPage.tsx:130-139`: the zero-issue body (`engine.diagnostics.cleanTitle`), already neutral.

## Done when

- The header icon and badge styling key off the issue count and severity: neutral or success at zero, destructive only when errors are present. A test pins both states.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` execution seat (app-shell metadata-admin). No spec contract change is needed.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, all states: "diagnostics all clear no problems destructive red styling" → 0 hits.

Re-checked by a cloud QA session dispatched under objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878 (maintainer ruling there, 「派云卡片复核这 7 条，授权里全部立卡。有时间间隔就行」).
